channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: NBER i3: Open Data Fellows Program 2027
item.description: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Innovation Information Initiative (i3) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 1,500 per fellow, at least five fellowships, plus travel reimbursement to present at the i3 Technical Working Group meeting in December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Pivotal Research Fellowship (2027 Q1)
item.description: Pivotal Research · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · £15,000 to £18,000 stipend (£18,000 for senior fellows, e.g. PhD, industry track record or strong publications) + travel to and from London + £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute.

item.title: Oregon Media Arts Fellowship 2026 (two USD 5,000 awards for Oregon media artists)
item.description: Portland Art Museum (PAM CUT) and Oregon Arts Commission · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of USD 5,000 each, no matching funds required; paid within two months of notification. No application fee.

item.title: Postdoctoral Fellow 2027, Crockett Lab (Princeton Psychology and University Center for Human Values)
item.description: Princeton University, Crockett Lab (Department of Psychology and University Center for Human Values) · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · USD 80,000 annual salary from a stable institutional funding source (not a cancellable grant).

item.title: CISAC (Stanford): Fellowships 2027-2028 (AI, Nuclear & International Security)
item.description: Center for International Security and Cooperation (CISAC), Stanford FSI · deadline 02 Dec 2026 · Funded in-residence fellowship. Predoctoral fellows receive stipends comparable to the Stanford Graduate Fellowships program, plus CISAC pays non-matriculated student tuition; postdoctoral and junior-faculty/professional fellows receive stipends commensurate with experience and Stanford's established minimums. Specific dollar figures are not published. No application fee.

item.title: Coding it Forward: Winter Fellowship 2027 (US civic tech placements)
item.description: Coding it Forward · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Paid full-time job placement: USD 20 per hour for applicants with a Bachelor's degree, USD 25 per hour for applicants pursuing or holding a graduate degree (Master's or PhD), at 40 hours per week for ten weeks (roughly USD 8,000 to 10,000 in total). Pay rates and work dates are non-negotiable. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic STEM Fellows Program 2027 (four-month AI-for-science fellowship, January to May 2027)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · USD 100,000 to 167,000 for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to USD 300,000 to 500,000 annualised), plus benefits; fellows are engaged through an employer of record on a fixed-term contract. No application fee.

item.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
item.description: Processing Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend over the 8-month fellowship, plus open-source software mentorship, cohort collaboration, professional development and public presentation opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship 2027 (USD 38,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 38,000 for the six-month fellowship, covering the immersive cultural exchange in New York City. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Leibniz Summer Fellowships 2027 (ZZF Potsdam, contemporary history)
item.description: Leibniz Centre for Contemporary History Potsdam (ZZF) · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of EUR 3,000 per month for two months (EUR 6,000 total each), plus office space, computer facilities, specialist library access and participation in ZZF's academic community. No application fee.

item.title: Internet Society Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Internet Society · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · Project stipend of up to USD 5,000 (upon submission and approval of the project budget), plus travel support to attend a global or regional Internet event and a dedicated mentor aligned with the project area. No application fee.

item.title: Loeb Fellowship 2027-28 at Harvard Graduate School of Design
item.description: Harvard Graduate School of Design · deadline 05 Jan 2027 · Stipend of USD 57,500 for the academic year (taxable), plus housing for fellows and their families coming from outside the Boston/Cambridge area through 30 June, and a travel grant covering approximately one economy round trip home per semester. No application fee.

item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 11 Feb 2027 · Non-recoupable grants of AUD 80,000 (single continuous placement of up to 6 months) or AUD 100,000 (multiple placements over up to 12 months), plus up to AUD 5,000 for carers' and/or accessibility costs. Up to 10 fellows annually.

item.description: The Center for Art & Advocacy · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 in unrestricted funds plus USD 10,000 in project development funds per fellow, awarded annually.

item.description: The Open Notebook · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 6,600 stipend over the twelve-month part-time fellowship, plus one-on-one mentoring from an experienced science journalist and published clips at The Open Notebook. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: Andrew Carnegie Fellows Program 2027
item.description: Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline 13 Nov 2026 · USD 200,000 over one to two years for research and writing toward a book or major study. NOTE: institutional nomination required; individuals cannot apply directly.

item.title: Culture Push: Fellowship for Utopian Practice 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, feedback and mentoring. No application fee.

item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Disability Arts + Dreaming Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, a Thought Partner, mentors in the field, and access check-ins, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Climate Justice Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

No application fee.

item.title: Wave Farm: 2027 Research and Production Program (Transmission Art Residencies and Radio Art Fellowships, NY)
item.description: Wave Farm · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend for each 10-day residency; USD 2,000 for each two-month Radio Art Fellowship. No application fee.

item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months (EUR 19,200 total), plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (the fellow pays EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs), a subsidy of up to EUR 4,000 for exhibition activities and a EUR 2,000 travel budget. item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: Transluce: Governance & Policy Fellow (San Francisco)
item.description: Transluce · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year salary plus benefits. Full-time; part-time possible for exceptional candidates.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary

Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). item.description: Kaete Hamburger Centre for Cultural Practices of Reparation (CURE), Saarland University · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Up to twelve fellowships. One round trip to Saarbruecken is reimbursed, a fully equipped individual workspace is provided, and an apartment can be arranged for around EUR 1,250 per month. Eligible accompanying family members may receive additional support. No application fee.

item.description: A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Fully funded fellowship: private studio and accommodation, round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget, and a production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for materials and production (excluding living expenses). No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: AAPI Fund: Creative Catalyst Fellowship 2027 (theme Belonging)
item.description: AAPI Civic Engagement Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to eight artists each receive USD 30,000 to produce new work. Also covered: the two-day Fellows retreat (travel and accommodation paid by the AAPI Fund), an accomplished communications consultant, digital advertising, community introductions, exhibition placement support and replica development (posters, books, calendars) promoting the finished work. No application fee.

item.title: Tilting Axis Fellowship 2027 for Caribbean-Based Practitioners (with Nieuwe Instituut)
item.description: Tilting Axis, with Nieuwe Instituut, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, Fresh Milk (Barbados), RAA! (Aruba) and Instituto Buena Bista (Curacao) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,500 stipend per fellow, plus up to EUR 1,000 travel budget for research-related movement and full coverage of airfare and Netherlands programming during the visit. No application fee.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028

Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: NARS Foundation: Curatorial Fellowship 2027 (NYC)
item.description: NARS Foundation · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend for the six-month fellowship, plus sustained access to the NARS international and US artist residency community and staff support for the resulting exhibitions. No application fee listed for the curatorial track.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Artistic Fellowships at HBK Braunschweig (Fine Arts and Sound Art)
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months, plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (fellows pay EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs) and an allowance for project and travel costs. 7 fellowships: 5 in fine arts and 2 in sound art. No application fee.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Summer Fellowship US 2027 (Washington DC)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 29 Jan 2027 · USD 2,000 per week subsidy, plus a USD 10,000 relocation/housing stipend for DC-based fellows and covered travel, accommodation and meals for the Convening Week; higher subsidies possible for exceptional candidates. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Winter 2027 Fellowship (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 19,200 stipend plus USD 24,000 compute budget, with free housing and food, travel covered, and J-1 visa sponsorship if needed. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI Fall Research Fellowship in AI Safety 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI AIxBiosecurity Research Fellowship Fall 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits and GPUs), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.description: Federation of American Scientists (Day One Project) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend for the part-time fellowship (about 5 hours per week), plus a USD 1,000 merit award for the most actionable policy memo and advocacy plan. No application fee.

item.title: ERA:AI Fellowship 2027 (Winter cohort, Cambridge)
item.description: ERA Fellowship · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · GBP 10,000 stipend for the 10-week fellowship, plus visa support, travel expense coverage and meals during working hours. Top performers can receive 6+ month extensions through the Research Scholars programme. No application fee.

item.title: Mycelia Fellowship 2026 (Social Resonance Lab)
item.description: Social Resonance Lab · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend per fellow; two fellows selected for the inaugural cohort

item.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Tech Policy Press · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend per fellow, paid quarterly. Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.title: European Cultural Foundation: Academic Research Fellowship (ECF Historical Archives)
item.description: European Cultural Foundation, hosted at the Historical Archives of the European Union · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 grant to support a research stay at the HAEU, covering travel, accommodation and living expenses. The parallel Artistic Research Fellowship carries EUR 10,000 and additionally covers artistic production. No application fee.

item.title: 10 new fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.
  • True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.
  • Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.
  • Kluge Fellowships at the Library of Congress 2027
    https://www.loc.gov/programs/john-w-kluge-center/chairs-fellowships/fellowships/kluge-fellowships/
    John W. Kluge Center, Library of Congress · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 5,000 per month for a residency of four to eleven months, so USD 20,000 to USD 55,000 depending on the tenure awarded. Twelve Kluge Fellowships are awarded each year. Stipends are paid monthly by electronic transfer to a U.S. bank account. No application fee, no participation fee.
  • BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.
